name: @spin/theme
description: DTCG JSON in, token trees out — the theme pipeline behind spin.

scripts.schema: bun eval "const { spinThemeJsonSchema } = await import('./src/contract/schema.ts');await Deno.writeTextFile('schema.json', JSON.stringify(spinThemeJsonSchema(), null, 2) + '\n');console.log('wrote schema.json');"
scripts.types: bun eval "const { parseTokens, generateTypes } = await import('./src/index.ts');const { silkTheme } = await import('./src/themes/index.ts');const parsed = parseTokens(silkTheme);if (!parsed.ok) throw new Error(parsed.error);await Deno.writeTextFile('src/theme-types.d.ts', generateTypes(parsed.tree));console.log('wrote src/theme-types.d.ts');"
scripts.skill: bun eval "const { renderSkill } = await import('./src/skill/index.ts');const template = await Deno.readTextFile('./skill/SKILL.md');console.log(renderSkill(template));"
